description:
About the Scholarship

Bioceb trains engineers for the sustainable bioeconomy, combining biological and chemical engineering across a consortium coordinated from AgroParisTech. The 2027-2029 application round runs from 3 November 2026 to 19 January 2027 (11:30 Paris CET), giving bioengineering applicants a clear early-season target.

OpportunityBioceb – European Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy (Erasmus Mundus)
HostBioceb Consortium (AgroParisTech)
LocationParis (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline19 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Bioceb trains engineers for the sustainable bioeconomy, combining biological and chemical engineering across a consortium coordinated from AgroParisTech. The 2027-2029 application round runs from 3 November 2026 to 19 January 2027 (11:30 Paris CET), giving bioengineering applicants a clear early-season target.

Programme Highlights

  • AgroParisTech-coordinated programme with four European mobility tracks
  • Two-and-a-half-month application window closing 19 January 2027
  • Focus on bio-based materials, industrial biotech and circular processes
  • Graduates move into biorefineries, bio-based chemicals and sustainable manufacturing

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's degrees in bioengineering, chemical engineering, biotechnology or adjacent disciplines are the natural fit; English evidence follows the standard Mundus checklist.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the Bioceb application portal after 3 November 2026 and submit before 19 January 2027 at 11:30 Paris time — the portal enforces the cut-off strictly. Key deadline information: 19 January 2027 (11:30 Paris CET); application period 3 November 2026 – 19 January 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Bioceb Consortium (AgroParisTech)

The Bioceb consortium is coordinated by AgroParisTech and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy with European partner universities and industry associates.

Official website: https://www.bioceb.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 19 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
